name: selvara-deploy-tooling
description: Isolated, lockfile-pinned install of the Vercel CLI used only by the deploy workflows. Kept apart from the app's dependencies so the deploy token never meets application code.
_overrides_comment: Patched versions of vulnerable transitive dependencies, restricted to the SAME major version each package is already on (so behaviour cannot change). Remaining advisories need a different major version and are tracked in audit-baseline.json. Verified: the CLI installs, runs and completes 'vercel build' for this project with these pins.
